column1: I am a junior software engineer with three years of hands-on experience in software design, development, testing, and automation. I recently started a graduate position at VXT where I have quickly adapted to the team and the tech stack. I am driven by my desire to improve and I enjoy the challenge of solving complex problems. I generally prefer to dive deeply into topics where possible but I can also simply solve the problems when time is a constraint. I take pride in writing clean, maintainable code that balances both business objectives and user needs.

In addition to my industry experience, I have four year of professional experience tutoring computer science and engineering at university. This has honed my ability to explain complex concepts clearly, collaborate effectively, and approach challenges with both analytical rigor and creative thinking. I am eager to continue growing as a software engineer, take on new responsibilities, and contribute to products that make a meaningful impact for users.
